answer: An attacker who floods the jury with fake votes also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes, because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer. So the design does not rely on catching every cheat — it makes cheating unprofitable, which is a far more stable defense than any whitelist ever could be.. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. Consider a lagoon as the anchor of the cost.
